defect: Untracked files are listed without -z, so a non-ASCII path arrives git-quoted and names no file.
The diff against HEAD is read without -z, so a changed non-ASCII path arrives git-quoted and names no file.
Before the first commit the failed diff against HEAD is returned as the changeset, so an unborn repository cannot be searched.
Tracked files are listed without -z, so a non-ASCII path arrives git-quoted and every listed path runs together.
The diff against HEAD reads only the index, so an unstaged edit to a tracked file is left out of the changeset.
The fixture config sets no hooks path, so a developer's global hooks run on every fixture commit and a failing one fails the fixture.
The fixture config leaves signing to the developer's global config, so a fixture commit invokes gpg and fails or stalls without it.
The fixture config sets no user email, so a fixture commit fails on a machine whose global config forbids a guessed identity.
The orchestration initRepo stops applying the shared fixture git config, so its commits run under the developer's global hooks, signing and identity.
